# Rido

> Rido is a shared e-scooter and e-bike micro-mobility service launching on the Costa del Sol, Spain. Zero-emission shared vehicles available via a mobile app. Operated by Go2 Place S.L.

## About
Rido is a shared micro-mobility company preparing to offer e-scooters and e-bikes for rent by the minute via a mobile app. The service is launching on the Costa del Sol (Málaga province, Andalusia); the launch towns will be announced soon. Rido is built and operated by a local Costa del Sol team and is committed to zero-emission transport, swappable batteries and responsible recycling.

Status: pre-launch. Fares, launch towns and app store listings will be announced at launch. Nothing on this site should be read as a current price, a live fleet size or a rider count.

## How It Works
1. Join the waitlist at https://rido.bike#download
2. Download the Rido app (in development for iOS and Android)
3. Find a Rido vehicle near you on the in-app map
4. Scan the QR code on the handlebar to unlock
5. Ride following traffic rules and bike lanes
6. Park in a designated area shown in the app
7. End the ride and pay only for what you used

## Pricing
Fares will be announced at launch. Planned plan structure: Pay as you go, Rido Pass (subscription) and Day Pass. Exact pricing is always shown in the app before a ride starts.

## Vehicles
- **Rido Scooter** (e-scooter): 45 km range, 25 km/h top speed, 120 kg weight limit, swappable battery, dual brakes, turn signals, front and rear lights plus brake light and reflectors, ≥203 mm puncture-resistant wheels, beginner mode (15 km/h), GPS tracking and geofencing, helmet included.
- **Rido Bike** (e-bike, pedal assist): 60 km range, 25 km/h assist, 130 kg weight limit, swappable battery, adjustable saddle, front cargo basket, integrated lights, puncture-resistant tyres, step-through frame.

## Spanish VMP regulation (2026)
Rido's e-scooter fleet is being prepared to meet Spain's new personal mobility vehicle (VMP) rules from the DGT, in force from 1 October 2026: certified vehicles, registration with an identification sticker, civil liability insurance, anti-tampering motor limited to 25 km/h, and mandatory helmet use for e-scooter riders nationwide.

## Cities
Launch towns on the Costa del Sol will be announced soon. Spanish-language site: https://rido.bike/es

## Safety
- Helmet included with every scooter; mandatory for e-scooter riders in Spain from 1 October 2026
- One rider per vehicle (tandem detection)
- No riding under the influence
- Park in designated areas only
- Beginner mode available (15 km/h)

## Sustainability
- Zero direct emissions
- Swappable and recycled batteries
- Vehicle recycling programme at end of life
- Impact figures will be published after the first year of operation (no projections are claimed)

## Partners
Turn-key shared-mobility operation for Spanish towns: certified fleet, rider app, operations tooling and aligned economics. Enquiries: info@rido.bike
